description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutablePayload' that implements the 'Payload' interface. It provides methods for creating, manipulating, and serializing payload data structures, including JSON serialization/deserialization, within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter' package. The class includes nested builder class, overrides standard methods, and handles optional fields.

classes.name: ImmutablePayload
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Payload interface, encapsulating payload data with associated fields like path, value, extra, status, revision, timestamp, metadata, and fields, and providing JSON serialization.

classes.name: ImmutablePayload.ImmutablePayloadBuilder
classes.description: Nested builder class for constructing ImmutablePayload instances in a fluent, mutable manner.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutablePayload instance from a JsonObject, parsing required and optional fields, and handling JSON conversion.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for creating an ImmutablePayload with specified path.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the MessagePath of the payload.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonValue of the payload, if present.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing additional JsonObject data associated with the payload.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns an Optional HttpStatusCode associated with the payload.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional Long indicating the revision number.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional Instant representing the timestamp.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ImmutablePayload to a JsonObject with all set fields.
